# Try greedy approach to find a large clique
def find_clique_greedy(start_vertex):
    clique = [start_vertex]
    candidates = set(adj[start_vertex])
    while candidates:
        # Pick the candidate with the most connections to remaining candidates
        best = None
        best_score = -1
        for v in candidates:
            score = len(candidates & adj[v])
            if score > best_score:
                best_score = score
                best = v
        if best is None:
            break
        clique.append(best)
        candidates = candidates & adj[best]
    return clique

best_clique = []
for v in range(n):
    clique = find_clique_greedy(v)
    if len(clique) > len(best_clique):
        best_clique = clique
        print(f"Found clique of size {len(clique)} starting from {v}: {clique}")

print(f"Best greedy clique: {best_clique}, size: {len(best_clique)}")
